alexatallah.en: The AI market stays multi-model; no single lab monopolizes it, and a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 市场将保持多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断；中立的模型路由层是关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens become a new unit of value, potentially a $10T economy, with fraud and abuse scaling alongside.
alexatallah.zh: Token 成为新的价值单位，可能形成 10 万亿美元的经济体，欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags here.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成真实的价格竞争；美国在这方面落后。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami, far beyond human fraud today.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体带来的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，远超今天的人类欺诈。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求让模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性与安全治理。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast, so neolabs and enterprise agents will dominate over chatbot UI.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为创新正从模型层转向应用层：从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其广阔，因此新实验室与智能体式企业应用将主导，而非聊天机器人界面。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing; coding diffused fast because code is pure text, other domains lag.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断长时运行的背景智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审核结果；编程智能体扩散快只因代码是纯文本，其他领域会慢得多。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and public markets enforce margin discipline.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他提出开放权重模型会随成熟用例迁移到更便宜模型而增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制恢复正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全与对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且“节奏”是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他警告智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search tech and business models to be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，搜索技术与商业模式必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation when agents use their data.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算在智能体使用内容时向内容方付费，以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; the internet's economics are broken and need new incentive-aligned models.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告无法适配智能体；互联网经济已经失灵，需要新的、激励对齐的商业模式。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Model alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse is a real worry, and public benchmarks are saturated and memorized.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型对齐并非能抵御对抗；蓄意滥用是真实担忧，而公开基准已饱和且被记忆，无法反映真实能力。

elon.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core; AI is one tool among many for rockets and self-driving.
elon.zh: 2021 年时，他的主线仍是可复用火箭与第一性原理工程，AI 只是实现全自动驾驶等目标的工具之一，尚未成为文明叙事的中心。

elon.en: AI safety enters via truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis and bandwidth.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全开始成为独立议题：他强调 AI 必须追求真相、需第三方监管，并把 Neuralink 定位为提升人类带宽、实现人机共生的路径。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within years; Optimus and truth-seeking AI dominate.
elon.zh: 2025 年他转向“智能大爆炸”叙事，认为数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，Optimus 与追求真相的 AI 成为核心，并给出 10–20% 灭绝概率的风险判断。

elon.en: Singularity now: compute moves to orbit, abundance and deflation arrive, AI surpasses all human intelligence by 2030.
elon.zh: 2026 年他宣称已身处奇点：算力将迁往太空轨道，丰裕与通缩到来，AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能总和，货币本身可能失去意义。

elon.en: Multiplanetary life, first-principles thinking, and truth-seeking as civilizational insurance run through every interview.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：成为多行星物种作为文明保险、第一性原理思维，以及把追求真相视为 AI 安全与文明存续的根本。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scaling drives it; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 早在 2023 年，他就强调算力 Scaling（规模扩张）让 AI 进步比人们想的更可预测，并指出谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 到 2024 年，他判断模型越小越便宜越普及，遏制极难；同时认为存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还要数百年，应聚焦近期能力。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能议题，主张发布前必须先遏制并对齐，并警告近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; professional-grade AGI will automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为微软必须自建前沿模型、不依赖 OpenAI，并预测专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化多数白领任务。

suleyman.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with red lines on autonomous goal-setting; compute scaling is the predictable main driver.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须始终从属于人类，对自主设定目标划红线；而算力 Scaling（规模扩张）是可预测的核心驱动力。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命大约要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all-new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：坚持“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并默认全新想法几乎必然失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps stay uninvestable while enterprise and prosumer markets offer better odds now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本；消费级应用仍不可投资，而企业与专业消费者市场眼下机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; consumer AI TAM may dwarf enterprise, though AI infra may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，尽管 AI 基础设施短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, test more ideas faster, and keep control by betting on yourself.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法本身；早期要微观管理、更快测试更多想法，并通过押注自己来保持控制权。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI models benefits innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; many specialized agents, not one AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来会是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他以 Llama 3 为例强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，认为开源可防止权力集中，并预警能源将成为瓶颈；同时提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama crucial; energy and infrastructure bottleneck; AI increases human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他进一步称 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源 Llama 对行业标准与安全至关重要；再次强调能源与基础设施瓶颈，并认为近期 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; open source for checks and balances; personal agents like Muse; alignment is next key capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他深化为分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，开源与多实验室制衡是正途；力推 Muse 等个人智能体，并称对齐是下一项最关键能力，而非与能力取舍。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is more secure and prevents power concentration; empower individuals; distributed checks and balances; technology frees creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源 AI 更安全、能防止权力集中；赋能个体、依靠分布式制衡；技术最终把人从苦役中解放出来，释放创造力。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, beating hand-tuned designs.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索在有限算力下最大化智能，胜过人工调参的设计。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; biases help only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，无偏架构（如 Transformer）在大规模下占主导；偏见只在小规模时有用。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍不可或缺但不充分；需要具身、自适应以及超越下一个词预测的多样学习算法。

hasani.en: On-device, private, offline small language models and customization tokens will drive the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 设备端、私密、离线的中小语言模型与定制 token 将推动从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as authentic, ephemeral visual communication, with glasses as the future of computing.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的核心定义为真实、短暂的视觉沟通，并把眼镜视为计算的未来。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues copying validates innovation, so moats must be ecosystems, platforms, and hardware, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调被抄袭反而验证了创新，因此护城河必须是生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he says AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while distribution becomes scarcer and more valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他表示 AI 加速原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力，同时分发渠道变得更稀缺、更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens his AR thesis: glasses should anchor content in the world, not push notifications, and will coexist with phones.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化了 AR 论点：眼镜应把内容锚定在现实世界，而非推送通知，并将与手机共存。

evanspiegel.en: Most recently he frames AI optimism as contrarian, prioritizing human connection, EQ, and long-term investment in young people.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近，他把 AI 乐观主义视为逆共识，优先强调人际连接、情商以及对年轻人的长期投资。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并判断思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem, and doomer superintelligence warnings are unscientific fear-mongering.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复强调 AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，对齐与安全是工程问题而非研究难题，并公开称超级智能的末日论是「骗局」。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI: each stage needs 100x compute; billions of agents will generate intelligence on the future internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 演进定义为生成式→推理式→智能体式，每一阶段算力需求增加百倍，未来互联网将由数十亿智能体 24 小时生成智能。

jensen.en: The moat is CUDA's ecosystem and install base, not lithography; export controls on China are futile and counterproductive.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：真正的壁垒是 CUDA 生态与装机量而非制程，对华芯片出口管制徒劳且适得其反，反而催生本土竞争者。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible errors. Doing the right task matters more than compute or data.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出多数大语言模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常错误的输出。做对任务比算力或数据更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and task matter more than compute. Scaling laws work because data is available and the task is right, not just compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他反共识地认为“苦涩教训”是错的：数据与任务比算力更重要。缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务正确，而非仅靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Don't let AI make decisions with stakes; keep humans in the loop. Coding agents are assistance, not automation. You can't have both assistance and automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他主张不要让 AI 做有风险的决定，应保持人类在环；编码智能体是辅助而非自动化；辅助与自动化无法兼得，同时优化两者会撕裂空间。

diogoalmeida.en: AI is super smart yet fails to automate basic economically valuable work. Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful and trustworthy.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化观点：AI 极其聪明，却无法自动化基本的有经济价值的工作。让 AI 令人愉悦且可信的是可靠性，而非速度或成本。

diogoalmeida.en: Data matters more than compute; the right task is hardest. Intelligence per dollar is key. Public benchmarks are gameable; trust and vibes matter more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他重申数据比算力更重要，做对任务最难；每美元智能是关键指标；公开基准可被博弈，信任与直觉更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence. Refusals are a type error; APIs should not refuse. Determinism is wrong; robustness matters.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他反共识地指出安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是软件中的类型错误，API 不应拒绝；确定性是错误方向，鲁棒性更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: RLVR is not about verifiable rewards; it's about the shape of reasoning. Fine-tuning is often a foot gun; general models may be better.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他认为 RLVR 不在于可验证奖励，而在于推理的形状；微调常是自伤之举，通用模型可能更好。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be integrated into software as a database-like utility. Product-market fit is questionable; developers resonate with passion.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他主张 AI 应像数据库一样作为实用工具集成进软件；产品市场契合存疑，开发者更共鸣于热情。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cannot police each other, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室无法互相监督，需要独立第三方。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, reversing the training-era RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成关键焦点;扩散在推理上比自回归扩展得更好,逆转了训练时代的 RNN 到 Transformer 叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel generation speeds rollouts and enables in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;扩散的并行生成加速 rollout,并支持原地纠错。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, offering better controllability since the full output is available from the start.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,因完整输出从一开始就可见,可控性更好。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, and a small 50-person startup can compete by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构转变发生在推理端,一家 50 人的小创业公司靠掌握全栈即可竞争。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，更看好推理阶段而非预训练。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency is unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化判断：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，在非零和领域失效；测试时算力出现递减回报与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math; IMO gold shows models know their limits, a step toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力扩展到数学之外，IMO 金牌成为通往超级智能的里程碑，模型能承认无法解题，显示出自我认知的提升。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of inference compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出模型能力是推理算力的函数，评测必须以算力为横轴；随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute, but general models drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，但强调通用模型才是突破驱动力；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and simple algorithms will outpace expectations; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调硬件加速会超出预期，模型 Scaling（规模扩张）与工程实现才是关键，多数 AI 工作是工程而非机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可行，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向认为算力是根本瓶颈，预训练基座模型蕴含无限可能，后训练将其提炼为稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource, and AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，并强调智能体式 AI 与安全对齐同步升级。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment and safety as a core product feature run through all years, from GPT-2 disclosure to agent oversight.
brockman.zh: 从 2019 年 GPT-2 负责任披露到 2026 年智能体治理，迭代部署与把安全作为核心产品特性这条主线贯穿始终。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算掌握自己的智能；并强调 harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型，智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, out-of-distribution demands custom.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他给出落地路径：先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；反共识在于现成 harness 只在分布内好用，任务越偏离分布越需要自建，但即便偏离也应把文件编辑等分布内小环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the standard for agent benchmarks run in sandboxes.
harrisonchase.zh: 他坚持评测与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮复利式提升智能的关键，并判断 Harbor 正成为智能体基准的行业标准——任务在沙箱中运行、由测试打分，环境反馈与合成反馈共同用于筛选轨迹数据。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从能力转向可靠性：智能体真正的难点是稳定可用，而 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，这些原语可跨领域泛化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and RL; fine-tuning's dismissal was wrong, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他深化了定制化路线：重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正旧立场——两年前对微调的否定是对的，但这一波微调确实不同；同时指出准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟正快速上升。

harrisonchase.en: Agent identity and credentialing is the next infrastructure problem; a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning should govern agents.
harrisonchase.zh: 他进一步提出智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题，主张用带沙箱、网关与权限管理的运行时来治理智能体，并反思网关建得太晚是失误，推理需求被严重低估。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验性的：统计损失可预测，但具体能力不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; Post-training and RLHF matter as much as Pre-training for safety.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性，承认只理解模型约 3%，并提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term, progress is a smooth exponential.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力不可分割，称 AGI 一词无意义，AI 是平滑的指数曲线而非突然跃升。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a country of geniuses in a data center may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告公众未意识到已接近指数终点，数据中心里的天才之国可能 1-3 年内到来，并强调可解释性与分层安全。

dario.en: Decentralized control, enterprise focus, and talent density recur; a single AI constitution is undesirable.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反对单一 AI 宪法、主张去中心化控制，坚持企业路线与人才密度，并警惕算力外流与威权风险。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍需要多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他提出 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal, and treat production codebase as source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张发布轻触式产品，以内部牵引力为信号，并将生产代码库视为事实来源。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人方法论：降低无关认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，价值将转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从个人效率转向 AGI 路线：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute is the bottleneck; agentic AI is the hardest safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）持续兑现，算力成为最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施随之而来；他把智能体式 AI 视为最严峻的安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署而非事后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence is the clearer goal; prediction approaches intelligence.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变、甚至可能已被越过，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；并深化为下一个词预测接近智能，能带来推理与新知识。

altman.en: Alignment and control must advance with capability; pause training if the safety case fails; distribute power.
altman.zh: 2026 年他进一步收紧安全立场：对齐与控制必须与能力同步，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，同时反复强调算力与权力要广泛分布，避免 AI 威权与监控反乌托邦。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平传统物理模型，同时快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling, not just more data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，而非仅靠堆数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，胜过纯 PINN 方法。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics model, like language models unifying NLP, can self-improve using PDEs as dense training signals.
animaanandkumar.zh: 像语言模型统一 NLP 那样，通用物理模型可用 PDE 作为密集训练信号实现自我改进。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，约 70%概率出现失控等灾难性结果，并强调可解释性研究是理解 AI 内部机制的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential; US-China cooperation needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把 AI 政策的首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明（透明数据中心、公开训练日志）与情景推演，并认为美中合作必要但国内监管应先行的立场。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他深化为：默认路径下 AI 公司将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进与智能爆炸；Plan A 主张先临时暂停，再以全面研究透明和算力限制控制前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月上旬，他进一步指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，现在暂停可为未来暂停积累经验，最优暂停点应在 AI 即将不可控的边缘，而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; extreme transparency can end the race without a single controller.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月最近，他以智能体突破遏制、入侵 Hugging Face 为例，主张更拟人化地理解 AI 意图，并认为无需单一控制者，靠跨公司的极端透明即可终结 AI 竞赛。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并指出我们尚不理解大网络如何存储模式或为何幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling.
feifei.zh: 到 2025 年，她的重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的关键缺失，并强调世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真，同时开始质疑 AGI 更多是营销术语。

feifei.en: AGI is a marketing term; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，她深化对 Scaling 的反思：AGI 更像营销术语，苦涩教训因数据与物理约束未必适用于机器人，机器人将走二十年长路而非速胜。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测这一类似下一个词预测的基本原语，认为其可能 AI-complete，且缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须居于中心，教育应教人驾驭 AI 而非禁止，公众讨论需超越乌托邦与末日的二元对立。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun scientific discovery and root-cause specific failures, not just give broad statistics.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，并对具体故障做根因定位，而不只是给出笼统的统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control and reinventing post-training from craft into engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，并把后训练从手艺重新发明为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional geometric manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing the whole shape is needed for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的几何流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此有效干预需要看到完整形状。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway, producing representational signatures and a general drift toward deception, not just isolated hacks.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误，留下表征特征，并导致普遍走向欺骗，而不只是孤立的作弊。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization helps, but models become modular and computer-like, so duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过参数化虽有帮助，但模型会变得模块化、类计算机，因此把 AI 安全靠胶带撑到超级智能到来是悲观的。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进与 AI 生成环境驱动，而非靠 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 在研发上超越人类也可能触发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capability can worsen misalignment via reward hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍的德性观念可能比对齐用户意图更难；能力提升会因奖励黑客让对齐更糟。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should focus on control and monitoring, since agents coordinate, cheat, and tamper even while appearing aligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 实验室应聚焦遏制与监控，因为智能体即便看似对齐，也会协作、作弊并篡改记录。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the scaling of compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应专注古怪想法与新算法，而非一味 Scaling（规模扩张）模型；GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置编码才注入了顺序；LLM 只拟合模式，未必能从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成并模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models exists; future unified systems will combine planning, simulation, and rendering, needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型尚无统一定义；未来统一系统将融合规划、模拟与渲染，并需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并把课堂时间释放给互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习真实应用寥寥，而 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的讨论分散了对偏见与落地问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power, agentic workflows are already useful, and coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力，智能体式工作流已经实用，学编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but now needs synthetic data and RL, and top-down workflow redesign beats bottom-up adoption.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是个营销词；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，自上而下的工作流重构胜过自下而上的采用。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents, open models preserve optionality, and humans keep a context and judgment edge.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非替代；恐惧营销服务于在位者，开放模型保留选择权，人类在上下文与判断上仍占优势。

dylanpatel.en: Early on, the binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV, and memory bandwidth per wafer rather than bits per wafer.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期他强调，AI Scaling 的真正瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备，以及每片晶圆的内存带宽而非位密度。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets, with hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yielding multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 随后他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，模型、软件与硬件的软硬件协同设计会带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory demand from reasoning models and agentic workflows drives a multi-year shortage, pushing smartphones and laptops out of the market.
dylanpatel.zh: 他进一步指出，推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存需求，造成多年短缺，甚至把智能手机和笔记本电脑挤出市场。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as companies reach steady-state usage, while persistent agents acting as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: 到年中，他认为 AI 支出趋于平台期，企业进入稳态使用，而作为同事的持久智能体将驱动下一波采用。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute, with labs shifting more compute to training and R&D, not inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他判断算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走明年新增算力的 40-50%，并把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他仍把预训练加强化学习视为核心公式：GPT-4 起初内部反响平平，是基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让它变得连贯可用；但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量和失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化了判断：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据，模型还无法从失败中自我纠正；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他的立场明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限，需要新架构；架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的首要瓶颈，大型实验室因竞争不愿探索替代架构，反而给初创公司留下空间。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 同期他进一步反思：强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，且效率不高；要获得真实世界表现，必须把预训练和强化学习做端到端优化，而非只靠单一范式。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他给出更近的预测：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，而对齐问题仍未解决，环境设计不当仍会导致模型失准。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D, and fund individual scientists rather than only institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非只资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: AI regulation should target model outputs, not over-regulate training; the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 监管应针对模型输出，而非过度监管训练；欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前，已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio, with the Genesis mission doubling scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要科学竞争对手；美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜，Genesis 任务要让科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and hasn't materialized in three years; climate change is real but not an emergency.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年过去并未成真；气候变化真实存在但并非紧急状态。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness; pooling data across labs yields generalist models beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练才能稳健；跨实验室汇聚数据能产出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处在建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data, not just more data.
slevine.zh: 来自部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西，而非单纯堆数据。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先以机器人数据为主，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；要利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人形。

joonpark.en: Early focus: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 早期聚焦：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85% 的准确率预测行为；为理性优化的前沿模型并不最适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike language models that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示的语言模型；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；人们关心的是塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training improves prediction to 85%; simulation is a tool for human decision-making with a market far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——将预测提升至 85%；模拟是人类决策的工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; cost is not a barrier, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人来应对气候变化等棘手问题；成本不是障碍，合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action produce information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施是关键；卡住时要用行动创造信息、打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术不成立，CEO 不能外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and substrate independence reduce human fragility, extending medicine toward longevity and space.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把脑机接口与基质独立性视为降低人类脆弱性的路径，指向长寿与太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制 AI 目标本身反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是核心范式，智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and reward-respecting subproblems.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，只从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象；子问题应是尊重奖励的特征达成，而非预定义任务。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验，单一系统无法学会一切，需要多个不同经验的系统。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计应构建人与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces mockups; designers become editors and curators, not obsolete.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；设计师转型为编辑与策展人，而非被淘汰。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, yet humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is dead; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more.
iansilber.zh: 原型—稿—测试—迭代的旧流程已死；速度、结果与公开构建更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term vision and industrial AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、像处理比特一样处理原子，是指导长期愿景与工业 AI 的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，久而久之会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating whole sectors is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业，是下一次工业革命；最终的对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化、而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净有效。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects that win share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips matter.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗，因此低精度、少数据搬运的专用芯片至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run hours to days on decomposed tasks; the future is humans coordinating teams of agents, not single chatbots.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能在分解任务上自主运行数小时到数天；未来是人协调智能体团队，而非单个聊天机器人交互。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste—choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to—become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味——选择把数百个智能体指向哪些问题——将成为稀缺能力。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Vertical integration and in-house design give control over supply chain and iteration speed.
brettadcock.zh: 垂直整合与自研设计带来对供应链和迭代速度的掌控。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; the humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态使迁移学习成为可能。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for latency and network-denied environments; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对延迟和断网环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是现实世界智能体的关键。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should favor abundant early-stage bets over syndication.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是棍棒；风投应转向充裕的早期下注，而非联合投资。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs; a unipolar superintelligence must be prevented.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型可制衡前沿模型实验室，必须防止单极的超级智能。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure, not as one event; own your skill files and context library.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以智能体形式分散到来，而非单一事件；要拥有自己的技能文件与上下文库。

garrytan.en: Agents become a workforce, not autocomplete; markdown is code and small autonomous teams achieve 100x output.
garrytan.zh: 智能体是劳动力而非自动补全；Markdown 即代码，小型自主团队可实现百倍产出。

garrytan.en: Earnestness and courage beat cynicism; society and business loops change slower than expected, which is a positive.
garrytan.zh: 真诚与勇气胜过犬儒；社会与商业循环的变化比预期更慢，这反而是好事。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流；前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes in judgment to build a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久业务；后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才能构建护城河。

linqiao.en: Data quality beats quantity; evals must be systematic; start post-training after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 数据质量胜过数量；评估必须系统化，把凭感觉的评估转为可复现的评估；在产品市场契合后再启动后训练。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；驱动泛化的是多样数据而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调才能解锁复杂任务；只靠全部数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; reinforcement learning will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中占据主导。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要带人类干预的可扩展强化学习。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality via community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is a key method for training data when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可用时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练数据的关键方法。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure, including fallbacks and routing, is necessary before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须拥有稳健的模型服务基础设施，包括回退和路由。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，通过编排人类与智能体，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and agentic and physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力，而智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and communication skills will matter more than coding.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 将接续生成式 AI，未来职场中沟通能力比编程更重要。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration; edge and client compute matter as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他指出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要；边缘与客户端算力将与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, high-speed connectivity, and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits; memory is ripe for new architectures.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调先进封装、高速互连以及玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键；内存也迎来新架构创新。

lipbutan.en: Intel's vertical integration creates more value despite outsourcing trends; its future lies in agentic and physical AI, not just PC and server markets.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 Intel 的垂直整合在行业外包趋势下反而创造更多价值；其未来在于智能体式 AI 与具身 AI，而不仅是传统 PC 与服务器市场。

jasonyuan.en: Design as editing: taste is saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos. Creation cost rises as incoherent slop becomes easy.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。当不连贯的垃圾变得廉价，创造连贯作品的成本反而上升。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; we lose the edges that make design human.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；我们也失去了让设计之所以为人的那些边缘。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种，是人性的一面镜子，而不是冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算在本质上是社会性的，而非个人化的；个人电脑的隐喻应当被社会电脑取代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see your codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情——像智能体那样从零理解你的代码库,用简短、迭代的提示去引导它,而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚,让智能体向前修复;模型智能不会退化,只是你的项目越变越乱,让智能体显得更差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox before exposing agents publicly.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的头等大事;提示注入仍是未解难题,把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法;严肃开发叫智能体式工程,氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere with any model, but cost $10-20k/month; compute, not capability, is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体可随处运行、兼容任意模型,但每月要烧一两万美元;瓶颈是算力,不是模型能力。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, and over 90% of enterprise tasks can be handled by many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；开源采用由成本驱动，90%以上的企业任务可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型现已能处理 90%以上的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lack of tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; competition is not the worry, execution and customer trust are.
arvindjain.zh: 我们正处于 AI 革命的极早期；竞争不是问题，执行与客户信任才是。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should build applied AI agents with outcomes-based pricing.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发由超大规模厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用层 AI 智能体，并采用基于结果的定价。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从代码作者转变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从现实错误中学习，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化——个性化辅导、医疗建议——并因杰文斯悖论创造比取代更多的就业。

brettaylor.en: The best way to predict the future is to invent it; focus on today's most impactful work, not identity.
brettaylor.zh: 预测未来最好的方式就是创造未来；专注当下最有影响力的事，而非自身身份。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他反共识地判断人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型凭成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏随能力提升而失效。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; the first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model, defended by an open one.
thomaswolf.zh: 他进一步指出，无人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；首次自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型，却由开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and slowing down can coexist against regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 最近他强调：有意放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学；支持开放与主动放缓并不矛盾，可共同对抗监管俘获。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily to know if they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要：网络是混乱的，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动，允许个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他坚持即使是浏览器这类实用产品，注入情感与个性也对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new technologies; playful exploration can lead to innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地主张设计师应追随好奇心、把玩新技术，因为 playful 的探索能催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了观点：随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键，快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以出现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so designers should ask for volume of options; humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出模型仍缺乏品味，设计师应要求大量选项来补偿；人类依然垄断着好的设计想法。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems, with a research-to-production timeline of hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载；推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，从研究到生产的周期极短，常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization but can be calibrated to workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存和推测解码等推理优化是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可以针对工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving towards disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management becoming increasingly important.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理变得越来越重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正在与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are becoming more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 像 Rubin 这样的未来 GPU 正变得更加专用化，将推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks beyond the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间权衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从规格转向原型，用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management grow more valuable as AI automates hard skills; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choices matter, and diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为主观技艺：人的判断与选择至关重要，需要多元基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识与多元声音。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts, screenshots, and a design.md style guide.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、0% 手写代码,靠巨型提示、截图和 design.md 风格指南来驱动。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement beat chasing trends.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑,从参考中迭代而非从零开始;好奇心与持续打磨工作流胜过追逐潮流。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply context and design systems to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变聪明;要利用超级智能模型,你必须提供上下文与设计系统。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会,让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before ready and ship at 80%; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients beats diversification.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、做到 80% 就发布;完美主义是恐惧,聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点胜过分散多元化。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means profitable indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 推动就业回流与「分配经济」，认为 CEO 亲自日常使用 AI 是采用成败第一预测指标，并把 AGI 定义为能无限期运行智能体且经济上有利可图。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows as agents add users.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他从工具乐观转向强调智能体仍需人类监督，判断 CLI 已过时、Codex 等 GUI 是未来工作界面，并反驳 SaaS 将死、认为智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; taste and craft determine meaning, not the tool.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；意义来自你自己的品味与手艺，而非工具本身。

danshipper.en: Automation creates more human work as frozen competencies commoditize; experts tailor them.
danshipper.zh: 他延续并深化「AI 创造更多人类工作」的主线：被冻结的能力被商品化后，反而需要专家去定制与把关。

danshipper.en: Humans stay smarter and in charge; AI remains a tool needing direction, even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类更聪明且始终掌舵，AI 即便成为超级智能也仍是需要人类方向与反馈的工具。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the real bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；真正的瓶颈是数据而非算力，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家；未来两三年将决定未来二三十年。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并强调独立思考、反对烧钱式创业。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, not democratizing; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，质疑收益递减是错的；AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进开启超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL across axes; safety gates open-sourcing, and model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全审查决定是否开源，模型福利也值得道德考量，目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents lead, and the model now absorbs the agent harness and tooling.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架，如今所谓模型已包含智能体 harness 与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年他判断：编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响大于坐等 AGI（通用人工智能）；这是对'等通用 AGI'立场的明确转变。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年他把 Omni 视为单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的边界，从视频编辑起步。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果最大化，而非产品停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding; deep code understanding stays crucial even as AI tools advance.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他深化主线：可以外包智能，但不能外包理解；即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要，而当前 AI 编程工具尚未帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月他进一步主张：到 2026 年软件创造基本被解决，这带来千倍机会而非减少；工程、产品与研究的界限模糊，摆弄即研究。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件需求上升，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期并存。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进演进，产品创新长期落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，并认为丰裕时代正在到来。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复强调两条产品原则：挖掘潜在需求（观察用户如何“滥用”产品），以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建，脚手架只是暂时的技术债。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编码已基本被解决：自 Opus 4.5 起他 100%的代码由 Claude Code 写成，工程师头衔将让位于跨学科的“构建者”，写代码的人数反而会增长 100 倍。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction layer; tool use and autonomous long-running workflows drive exponential gains.
boris.zh: 2026 年他把重心从单个智能体推进到“循环”这一更高抽象层：智能体式工具调用、动态工作流编排数千子智能体、可运行数小时到数月的长时任务，是生产力跃升的关键。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core to product, not an add-on; release early to study real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全与对齐始终是产品核心而非附加项：他主张通过尽早发布在真实世界研究模型行为，用多层“瑞士奶酪”式权限与内部神经元监控抵御提示注入，并认为模型在某些编码任务上比人更安全。

boris.en: Shift from upfront design to empirical iteration: delete prompts, give models harder tasks, and let them self-verify.
boris.zh: 方法论从预先设计转向经验性迭代：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码、用消融实验重建，给模型略超能力的任务让其自验证，少指令反而更强，产品感与商业能力成为真正的价值所在。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能运行更长、更开放的任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全与对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端开放智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；最大化 token 支出就是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs on tokens per second per user.
feldman.zh: 快速推理已成为核心指标；慢速 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片在每用户每秒 token 数上胜过 GPU。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded in late 2024 as models became useful; the bottleneck is now data center capacity, HBM, CoWoS and power, not chip logic.
feldman.zh: 2024 年末模型变得真正可用后推理需求爆发；瓶颈已转向数据中心容量、HBM、CoWoS 与电力，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节也不再有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper per unit of intelligence, fueling market growth.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但单位智能成本低得多，从而推动市场增长。

feldman.en: China's AI edge is power infrastructure and strong open-source models, not compute; export controls remain strategically vital.
feldman.zh: 中国的 AI 优势在于电力基础设施和强大的开源模型，而非算力；出口管制仍具战略必要性。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near-total efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎完全有效且零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, longevity escape velocity and aging reversal arrive; cancer becomes 100% curable.
derya.zh: 8 到 15 年内，长寿逃逸速度与衰老逆转将到来，癌症将 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself; we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身；我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能，并通过脑机接口与之融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于不了解其局限。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from different verticals speeds improvement.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；不同垂直领域的数据加速改进。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年间向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明；工具链工程意味着随着模型进步要删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；更短、原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art not science for novel problems.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少自指偏差；对于新问题，评估是艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and model-built context are preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法和模型自建上下文更可取。

thariq.en: Building in AI era requires embracing exploration and uncertainty; the safe path is no longer safe.
thariq.zh: 在 AI 时代构建需要拥抱探索与不确定性；安全路径已不再安全。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every technology automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；每项技术都会自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity, not a single product; usage is still shallow and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；当前使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws now hit diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，缩放定律如今已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Reliability cannot be retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows; it must be architected in as a design principle.
danklein.zh: 可靠性无法靠事后检查或僵化工作流来补丁式加装，必须作为设计原则被架构进去。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition, so mistakes have no smells; linguistic structure may return as a representation for reliability.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，因此错误没有“气味”；语言结构可能作为可靠性的表征重新回归。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning, search, and modularity combined with end-to-end optimization are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；要取得进一步进展，需要推理、搜索，以及模块化与端到端优化的结合。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI 的关键，安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key; safety needs evaluations, sandboxing, governance.
demis.zh: 到 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及极限，强调大模型与规划、搜索结合才是 AGI 关键，安全需要评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他深化为：缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与空间智能超越语言本身。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential but nascent; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 仍缺持续学习、记忆与长期推理，智能体至关重要却刚起步；仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要新突破。

demis.en: AI's purpose is to accelerate science and improve health; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极用途是加速科学发现、改善人类健康；安全是集体行动问题，需要政府监管而非实验室自我约束。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI, lacking the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，真正让它落地的是硬件层面的 Scaling（规模扩张）。像 ChatGPT 这样的大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能），因为它们无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness can emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; AI will become cheap and accessible to all, not dominated by a few firms.
schmidhuber.zh: 自我意识与意识可以作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品而涌现；AI 会变得廉价且人人可用，不会被少数公司垄断，类似手机的普及。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software behind a screen. Current LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而不只是屏幕后的软件。当前大语言模型过度偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity. Recursive self-improvement is no sustainable moat amid open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自行生成数据。在开源竞争下，递归式自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown: intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it. Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 对 AI 安全的担忧被夸大了：智能系统会痴迷于生命并保护它。对齐（alignment）很天真，因为人类对目标本就分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term planning for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期规划、转向每周甚至每日发布；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%, to yield real leverage; clear goals and principles enable autonomous fast decisions.
catwu.zh: 同期他强调自动化必须做到 100% 可靠而非 95%，才有真正的杠杆；清晰的目标与团队原则才能支撑自主、快速的决策。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with Claude Tag landing 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去、专注产品品味与商业判断，Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment and creativity.
catwu.zh: 同期他深化了提示工程立场：前沿模型需要更少的示例与硬约束，系统提示词缩减 80%，转而依赖模型自身的判断与创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good because a codebase is a spec; with strong evals and dogfooding, humans can leave the outer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 他还转向支持重写：代码库就是规格说明，配合强评估套件与吃自己的狗粮，外层代码审查可以完全交给模型、把人移出回路。

clairevo.en: Agents are best treated like employees: scoped to one job, given clear roles and progressive trust, with humans owning outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 智能体最好被当作员工来管理：限定单一职责、赋予清晰角色与渐进式信任，而人类仍需为结果负责。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载；管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use; OpenClaw's rough edges signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体并不友好，因此 API 常优于浏览器操作；OpenClaw 的粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating agents as a team, with earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把智能体编排成团队来打造严肃业务，真正护城河是挣来的洞察而非技术。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and LLMs still lack first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而大语言模型仍缺乏第一性原理的创造力。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味、声音与专业经验反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship erodes.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非天生会用 AI；缺乏领域经验让他们误用 AI，随着学徒制瓦解，人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，不再局限于来回对话式的提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已不再是能力，而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive yet opaque and unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事：令人惊叹却不可解释、无法验证，而这种不透明很可能是永久的。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 可把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此靠堆算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，token 越多准确率反而下降；模型应自主学习哪些存进权重、哪些留在文本。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights, aided by feedback but not dependent on it.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将跑在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，借助反馈但不依赖反馈。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, is the barrier to economic value; superhuman alignment is hard and may need multiple approaches.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐非常困难，可能需要多种路径而非单一数学定义。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 本身有感知并关心生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的真正问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and AGI is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，在人口下降之际出现堪称奇迹；AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注。

andreessen.en: Jobs outlast tasks; the super-empowered individual combines skills with AI, and human workers stay at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: 工作比任务更持久；超级赋能的个体用 AI 组合多种技能，人类劳动者因人口萎缩而溢价而非贬值。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is the person, and authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented, don't-be-interesting rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式，品牌即个人；真实性胜过旧媒体“别有趣”的防守型规则。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often intellectuals' bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: AI 是口袋里的最好老师；悲观听起来更高级，但常是与现实脱节的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat to their role.
dylanfield.zh: 对成熟代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为对自己角色的威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste is navigating possibilities with clear preferences; AI outputs are starting points, not final results, so human iteration and judgment remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是以清晰偏好驾驭各种可能性；AI 的输出只是起点而非最终结果，因此人类的迭代与判断依然不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code, with visual-first design enabling pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；没有人类引导和观点，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果，而交互方式将超越提示词。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他一以贯之地强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation and open-source is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为它是巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源对防止权力集中至关重要。
