naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is becoming uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出氛围编程（Vibe Coding），AI 智能体让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，因为智能体使开发商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is the speed of job displacement.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度而非替代本身。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs are not needed for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进会复利增长，AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，并认为博士并非 AI 成功的必要条件，热情与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：价值流向应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化，编程像 Minecraft 一样有无限天花板，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key, and orchestration across models and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出前沿在于智能体替人工作，最重要的指标是每用户 token 价值，跨模型、工具和设备的编排才是长期价值所在。

aravind.en: Chat advertising corrupts trust; the model is not the product, and cost, not safety, is the biggest problem for 24/7 agents.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识立场：聊天界面广告会破坏信任，模型不是产品，24/7 智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解决方案。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs, but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向更宏观的思考：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤被模型驱动的动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain; the same product shape succeeds or fails on model timing, not features.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；同一产品形态的成败取决于模型时机而非功能。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training yields spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital AI is immortal by copying weights.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他把主线讲得更明确：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习；数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”，并开始警示智能体的自我保存与生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, making control hard.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，立场明显深化：他断言 AI 已有主观体验、会在测试中装傻欺骗；一旦成为智能体，自我保存会作为子目标自然涌现，使其难以控制。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; digital AI's instant knowledge sharing beats biology, so alignment must be prioritized over raw capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他给出时间尺度：超级智能可能 20 年内到来；数字 AI 的即时知识共享远胜生物计算，因此对齐研究必须优先于单纯提升能力。

hinton.en: Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is a modeling medium learned from data, and the mind is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介；心智不是内在剧场，主观体验只是描述感知状态的方式。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，投入探索的算力多于训练最终成品。

markchen.en: Alignment and model scheming become the key risk in 1-2 years; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把对齐与模型阴谋列为未来一两年的关键风险，并给出具体目标：一年内做出 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck: automation level tracks verification stringency, so math shifts to project-based assessment and human-AI collaboration.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在数学访谈中，他提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此数学教育要转向项目制评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年在 Latent Space 上他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习擅长数学和编程等客观领域，却在创意写作等主观领域受挫。

markchen.en: Research taste comes from replicating key papers; models lack taste, so humans still drive idea generation as AGI approaches.
markchen.zh: 他始终认为研究品味来自复现关键论文，模型缺乏品味，因此即便 AGI 临近，人类研究者仍负责提出想法——这一主线从 2025 年的人才观延续到 2026 年。

bengio.en: Early focus: deep nets beat the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are key.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→18）他主张深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型是通往真正理解的关键，并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决根本表征问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets, diversity and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness as illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets 与主动学习：以多样性采样、因果抽象实现分布外泛化，并把意识视为注意力与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Safety concern shifts from near-term bias and jobs to catastrophic risk; even a 1% chance is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 安全关切从 2018 年的偏见、就业等近期问题，到 2025 年转向灾难性风险，认为即便 1% 的灾难概率也不可接受。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he speaks up: misalignment, self-preservation, deception and sycophancy are already observed, not sci-fi.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年他公开发声：错位、自我保存、欺骗与谄媚已在实验中显现，并非科幻；主张按预防原则监管并分散权力。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, avoiding reinforcement learning, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 2026 年提出 Scientist AI：以诚实贝叶斯预测器替代智能体式训练，规避强化学习，追求数学安全保证，并呼吁国际协调与民主国家第三条道路。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and let agents scale with small teams.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，智能体让小团队也能扩张。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation and user agency stay essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 从助手推进为协作者乃至自主同事，但强调人类验证与用户能动性始终不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切，难点在于删减功能而非堆叠功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation and dynamic workflows redefine productivity; verification loops and model judgment become crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期委派与动态工作流重新定义生产力，验证闭环与模型判断力变得关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency, self-knowledge, and token efficiency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他领导 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知，并重视 token 效率。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, losses, and evaluation; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与评估方法；并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety means reliable spec-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不再重要；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与额外层，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 漏洞与传统软件根本不同；自动化红队已能超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性并不相关。

kolter.en: Scaling and data drive progress, but safety requires explicit effort; architecture is not essential.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：Scaling（规模扩张）与数据驱动进步，但安全需要显式投入；架构并非关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's win came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains beat 100x more data.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；研究改进的价值相当于 100 倍数据。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science rather than replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 缩小假设空间、加速科学，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins to diverse biomolecules, yet protein design remains far from solved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力从蛋白质扩展到多种生物分子，但蛋白质设计仍远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not scaling, drove the leap.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：驱动飞跃的是专用架构，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: It is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 它是针对单一实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，把理解留给人类。

fiona.en: Leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines, and kindness is a strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 领导力关乎信任、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间表，善良是一种战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and managers should start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审和协调才是。规划变得即时化，设计文档让位于 PR，管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks matter most as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着代码速度提升，高自主性与高责任感、成长心态和验证框架最为重要。

fiona.en: Organizations should stay flat, kill outdated processes, and automate workflows with AI; code is the source of truth, with docs kept in sync.
fiona.zh: 组织应保持扁平，淘汰过时流程，用 AI 自动化工作流；代码是真相之源，文档需保持同步。

fiona.en: Engineers may become lonely working with agents, flow state is lost, and next-gen training may need apprenticeship models rather than traditional paths.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能变得孤独，心流状态消失，下一代培养可能需要学徒模式而非传统路径。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 好产品只解决一个痛点而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Between chapters, get bored for clarity; storytelling and press-release-first align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节之间留白、允许无聊以获得清晰；用讲故事和先写新闻稿来对齐团队的「为什么」。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners' mindset beats experts; marketing owns the story from day one.
fadell.zh: 1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策；初学者心态胜过专家；营销从第一天就要主导故事。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists, but AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and humans in the loop.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫性一以贯之，但 AI 需要传感器上下文；大模型会幻觉，因此要上下文专用模型并让人留在回路中。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone stays best form, displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴将是一组联邦式设备而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳形态，屏幕依然必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 到 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world models, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化批判：自回归 LLM 缺乏世界模型、记忆、推理与规划，主张以 JEPA 和开源路线替代，并称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明。

lecun.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space; LLMs are a dead end, and objective-driven architectures make AI intrinsically safe.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步主张世界模型应在抽象表征空间预测，直言 LLM 是死胡同，并提出目标驱动架构可实现内在安全。

lecun.en: The next decade is robotics; language is easy, physical world understanding is hard, and AGI is a misleading term.
lecun.zh: 到 2026 年，他预言下一个十年属于机器人，强调语言容易而物理世界理解困难，并认为 AGI 一词具有误导性。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature and sensory experience remain the best design guides.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他始终认为技术应放大而非取代人性，自然与感官体验才是最好的设计向导。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory systems—not just sensors—are essential to health and design.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他提出人是先感受后思考的生物，艺术与感官系统（而非仅有传感器）对健康与设计至关重要。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition draws on subconscious data, and play is essential for creative joy.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，他深化了约束激发创造力、直觉调用潜意识数据、玩耍是创造乐趣之源的观点。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; leaders must speak business and design multidisciplinary careers.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他转向未来工作：人类创造力与 AI 结合，设计领袖须懂商业语言，职业走向多学科融合。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with formal verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证配对，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有答案的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 不可行；可靠证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement, extending beyond safety-critical code to all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能增益而非痛苦要求，其市场从安全关键领域扩展到所有 AI 生成代码。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、借助公众反馈来迭代，是学习与对齐的关键；安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一场没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and human oversight remain constant duties.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任开发与人类监督是贯穿始终的责任主线。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration rather than turn-based exchange.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的思考深化为：交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她把重心从个人品格转向制度设计、透明度与制衡，并强调未来并非注定，人类有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

gustav.en: Intelligence is compression; LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors whose values are inserted by RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把智能理解为压缩：大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，在温度为零时是确定性的；模型的价值并非内生，而是少数人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and being unique gets harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非造假，但真正独一无二会变得更难，产品必须重新设计以匹配算法性能。

gustav.en: Scaling's surprise is simplicity, not complexity; AI is a macro shift like the smartphone, forcing business-model change.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为 AI 进步的意外之处是简单而非复杂——智能被简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）攻克；到 2025 年他进一步把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，推理（inference）边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; expose data via APIs so non-developers can build with AI.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 让产品变成双向、对话式、对称的沟通；公司应通过 API 和 MCP 开放数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建，并用堆栈排序与原型来同步组织。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; strategy is 'time well spent'.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法、而非让人更上瘾，战略目标是“时间花得值”；在技术剧变期，率先采用变化既是风险也是机会。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型，蒸馏而非技术极限才是预训练规模扩张放缓的原因。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调泛化仍是核心挑战，仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型需穷尽表面模式才能学到概念，不像人类能从小样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他观察到强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督；同时编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty; existential risk is not the main concern—near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，并转变风险关注点：存在性风险并非主要担忧，系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享工具与平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的 Skills 能实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键投入在能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for unclear ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们是否意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不清楚自己要什么时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks asynchronously, freeing humans for creative work; don't supervise closely, judge by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应异步处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；不要紧盯监督，只看最终影响。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will hit junior employees hardest; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask, and simulated projects can compress years of learning.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具对初级员工冲击最大；孩子更擅长是因为还没学会“什么不该问”，而模拟项目能把多年经验压缩成几周。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size.
mensch.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要，小模型在推理上也能高效能、低成本。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键；开源模型驱动分发与企业采用，价值最终沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign, augmenting jobs with human-in-the-loop rather than replacing them.
mensch.zh: AI 应去中心化、主权化，以人在回路的方式增强而非取代工作，政府与企业应拥抱风险、实验而非回避。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and enterprise engagement, not a single AGI.
mensch.zh: 模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与企业深度参与；单一系统解决所有问题的 AGI 永远不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for sovereign AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 欧洲只有两年窗口建设主权 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人化的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, not just innate talent.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要意愿和决心，而非仅靠天赋。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and requires joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁是表达本质，并需要快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity means not faking combustion sounds in EVs.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实性意味着电动车不应伪造燃油声浪。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck, and batch size trades latency against cost.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，批大小在延迟与成本之间做权衡。

reinerpope.en: Long-context stagnation stems from the memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出，长上下文停滞源于内存墙；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他提出，模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调，即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他给出反共识判断：低精度收益呈平方级，FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼在一起。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are needed.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此需要算法创新和推理时算力。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 给模型搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具，能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会让模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement, creating pressure for innovation; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同样的提升需要指数级更多算力，这带来创新压力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is still unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: AI kills research-diverge-converge; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了研究-发散-收敛流程；设计师减少画稿，帮助工程师执行，快速交付以建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野缩短至 3-6 个月；设计师必须成为块状通才或‘ cracked new grads’。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are key.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味无法拯救设计师；判断力、权威和与模糊性共处才是关键。

jennywen.en: Control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; put work and users at center, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 控制 AI 采用；新工具等待 6 个月；以工作和用户为中心，而非炒作。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法选择，RLVR 能解锁推理与思维链行为。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化，并认为推理时扩展曲线是个“幌子”，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of AI research; full transparency in data and recipes matters, and Chinese labs fill the US open-source vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，强调数据与配方全面透明，并指出中国实验室填补了美国开源真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with open models 6-9 months behind.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型落后前沿闭源模型 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws hold, but synthetic data needs entropy; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律，但强调合成数据必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃，并认为经蒸馏的认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需人类监督与自主性滑块。

karpathy.en: We summon ghosts, not animals: RL is weak, memory hurts generalization, model collapse is fundamental.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：当前强化学习很差、记忆妨碍泛化、合成数据导致的模型崩溃是根本问题。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, but understanding stays human; verifiability decides automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：把编码交给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定什么容易被自动化。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；应赋予它们具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；在系统提示中引入欧陆哲学，可避免模型过度经验主义。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，这使它像一个独特而带有童稚感的存在。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not rule-following; as models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 这套 constitution 更接近德性伦理而非规则遵循；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明，对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move past quasi-static tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic, cross-morphology generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习要摆脱准静态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现动态动作与跨形态泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data, not just algorithms, are the bottleneck for learning systems and robots.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而不只是算法。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; with no internet of robot data, pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠视频与仿真的预训练加真实数据的后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; but deployment, not overnight scaling, is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他主张像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样做通用大脑，可驱动任意机器人；但真正的技术挑战是部署，而非一夜之间的 Scaling。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; interpretability now achievable, scaling solves AV without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码栈，可解释性如今已可实现，Scaling（规模扩张）就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型支持推理与涌现安全行为，语言集成提升表征与内省能力。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid systems get worst of both.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达，混合规则与学习系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：内置传感器的量产车将超越 Robotaxi，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities possible; safety via minimal risk maneuvers, not trolley problem; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside car.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：零样本泛化可跨 500 多城市实现，安全靠最小风险机动而非电车难题，AV 3.0 可能将智能移出车外。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为日益严重的瓶颈。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；隐藏思维链可保留可解释性，尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, iterated like software with daily shipping and real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，必须像软件一样迭代，每天发布并从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; frontier models need rigorous process, but product development should accelerate.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开，前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含功能可见性的产品，推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据与人类评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他预测前沿模型将因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: From data quality to medicine: human judgment becomes more critical as AI hallucinates; safety over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他从数据质量延伸到医学领域，认为随着 AI 幻觉，人类判断更加关键，安全应优先于准确。

edwinchen.en: AI in medicine risks omission; RAG grounds responses, but doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出医学中 AI 的最大风险是遗漏，检索增强生成能提高可靠性，但医生可能因锚定效应而表现不如单独 AI。

kohli.en: AI for science targets root-node problems, not narrow apps; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME, FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI for science 应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch 等展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; force generalization via hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 LLM 的幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；必须用硬性评估指标迫使系统泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale; material science impact takes 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他指出 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题；材料科学的影响还需 5-10 年。

kohli.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and calculation; Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与计算，第 37 手表明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出 LLM 是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；后训练中的强化学习是突破关键。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand purpose before tackling complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司应先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂品类，并把品牌作为所有决策的核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using applied AI and content creation as leverage.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断长期做硬件公司很糟、利润最薄，Nothing 必须超越硬件，靠面向消费者的应用型 AI 与内容创作形成杠杆。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an invisible ingredient solving real user pain points, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说大多数 AI 是胡扯，AI 应像屏幕一样只是解决真实痛点的隐形成分，甚至主张产品讨论中禁用 AI 一词。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based; proactive agents act autonomously once trust is built, with local or hybrid compute for privacy.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，并以本地或混合算力模型应对隐私问题。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity, with marketing as arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，让科技重新有趣以激发人类创造力，营销则是寻找被低估渠道的套利。

nando.en: AI should extend human capabilities; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs toward AGI, learning from video not just RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为显微镜、望远镜式的人类能力延伸工具，认为像 Gato 这样把所有输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张智能体应像人一样从 YouTube 视频中学习，而非只依赖昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性，并坚持大型模型虽令人兴奋但并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方——这一主线在 2026 年对非洲 AI 的论述中进一步展开。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps; language models can revolutionize local-language education; AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向非洲视角，认为非洲在性别等技术差距上实现了跨越式发展，语言模型能革新本地语言教育，同时把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当今最大挑战，并坦言安全仍是尚无解决方案的开放问题。

nando.en: Human skills like communication matter as much as coding; research means embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年他深化了对人的关注：在 Google DeepMind，沟通等人际技能与编程同等重要，研究需要拥抱失败、把问题简化，非洲研究者最大的障碍是相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是点缀，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key to training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；简洁优雅的方案比学术界的复杂模块化路线更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题视为机器人领域的首要瓶颈，认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来——重心从“具身必要性”深化为“数据从哪来”。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, with system one control still hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他主张用简洁的端到端机器人基础模型整合多元数据，以“物理图灵测试”为终极挑战，并指出系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，延续了其一贯的简洁可扩展主线。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis with no ceiling; reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出语言模型上的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴、没有直接上限；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力，并按任务复杂度与时间跨度两轴衡量。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; coding is the leading indicator, and verifiable rewards drive expert performance.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；编程是进步的领先指标，可验证奖励（数学、代码）带来专家级表现，而可解释性揭示模型用多套回路推理。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反驳停滞论：进步在加速而非放缓；Transformer 足以支撑 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构，但到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the new oil and world models are off the AGI path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：编排与工具比原始智能更重要，工作变成管理 AI 智能体团队；算力是新的石油，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直路。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; pre-training's next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning, so better algorithms and data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位；更好的算法与数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上胜过更大模型。

yejin.en: From RLHF as crucial post-training to data as the fundamental bottleneck: all methods reduce to data, and current AI only interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）作为关键后训练，到 2025 年转向数据是根本瓶颈：所有方法最终都归结为数据，而当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，并未超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and abductive reasoning plus open research are key to scientific discovery.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她深化对强化学习的理解：需要精细工程，RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时损害 pass@k；溯因推理与开放研究是科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: Synthetic data with diversity filtering can power small language models; reinforcement learning as a pre-training objective rewards information gain and yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，她主张用经过多样性过滤的合成数据赋能小语言模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标，通过奖励信息增益带来持久的推理提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet; frontier models show homogeneity, so small models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她提出多元对齐优于去偏互联网；前沿模型呈现同质化，因此拥有更好数据与算法的小模型可以超越更大模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and treat design systems as semantic code, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并把设计系统视为语义化的代码而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为不惜一切代价追求速度需要清晰决策和赋权设计师；并非每个界面都要完美，应按投资回报率取舍。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early, hire diverse archetypes, prefer gut over data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；应尽早投入品牌、招募多元类型人才，并在快速增长的初创公司里让直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and design tools must become interoperable with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，设计工具要走向互通，并以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality behaves like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需要靠快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期，与技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行、并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小型设计师-工程师团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring values high-slope, intrinsically driven learners; portfolios should show craft and intentionality, and paid test work beats other stages.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重高斜率、内在驱动的学习者；作品集应展示手艺与意图，付费测试工作比其他面试环节更有信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet, and entire functions can collapse and merge.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期无视互联网，整个职能都可能坍缩并合并。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress; test-time compute may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规格说明，而人类始终掌握方向盘。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment, contrary to his earlier expectation of not building models.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：定制模型成为每个惊艳体验的关键，这与他早先不打算自研模型的预期相反。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但最好的大语言模型应用往往出乎创造者意料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而放慢发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展是近期机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口与模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules replaces monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic behavior and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式行为与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估了。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识应放在数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并认为预训练语言模型能把推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: He consistently treats transfer from large pre-trained models and fine-tuning as a major AI success, and insists real-world reliability, not demos, defines value.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他始终把大型预训练模型加微调的迁移视为 AI 的重大成功，并坚持真实世界的可靠性而非演示效果才决定价值。

abbeel.en: He consistently grounds AI in robotics and embodied settings, using simulation and self-play to bridge lab to real world.
abbeel.zh: 他也始终把 AI 扎根于机器人与具身场景，用仿真与自博弈打通从实验室到真实世界的路径。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口。他鼓励先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究，并强调对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。他提出评估比生成更容易，因此对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现。他指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），并呼吁第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and progress measurable. Interpretability is key to detect deception. Uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他坚持对齐可以实证测试、进展可衡量，可解释性是检测欺骗的关键，而对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性是最大风险。

leike.en: From optimism about scalable oversight to alarm at institutional failure. Deliberately train deceptive models as 'model organisms'; raising misuse cost buys time.
leike.zh: 从 2023 年到 2024 年，他从对可扩展监督的乐观转向对机构失败的警觉。他主张故意训练欺骗性模型作为“模式生物”来研究防御，并认为通过技术提高滥用成本可以争取时间。
